checks.name: deletion_between_pages
checks.code:
from feed import page
r=[{'timestamp':i,'id':str(i)} for i in range(5)]
a,c=page(r,None,2); b,_=page(r[1:],c,3)
assert [x['id'] for x in a+b] == ['0','1','2','3','4']

checks.name: same_timestamp_and_insert
checks.code:
from feed import page
r=[{'timestamp':1,'id':x} for x in 'abcd']
a,c=page(r,None,2); b,_=page(r+[{'timestamp':0,'id':'z'}],c,5)
assert [x['id'] for x in a+b] == list('abcd')
